task.title: Configure Linux source runtime settings
task.shortdesc: Set the database URL, host, port, reload mode, CORS, and documentation-site path used by the source-run BPM process.

prereq.p: The checkout dependencies are installed and migrations have been applied for the database you plan to use.

context.p: BPM reads environment variables with the BPM_ prefix and also supports a repository-local .env file. The default database URL is sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/bpm.db, which stores data in data/bpm.db.

step.cmd: Create the local data directory and define the database URL.

info.p: For repeatable source runs, the same value may be stored in a local .env file that is not committed.

step.cmd: Set network and reload values for the local source process.

info.codeblock: export BPM_HOST="127.0.0.1" export BPM_PORT="8000" export BPM_RELOAD="true"
info.p: Use loopback for local verification. Binding to a shared interface is an operational decision outside this source-runbook boundary.

The source defaults include BPM_ENABLE_CORS, BPM_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS, and BPM_DOCUMENTATION_SITE_DIR. Keep permissive CORS only for controlled local evaluation, and point BPM_DOCUMENTATION_SITE_DIR at an installed static documentation site when one is available.

step.cmd: Start BPM from the repository script.

info.p: The Makefile runs uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000. Keep the foreground terminal open so startup messages and tracebacks are visible.

result.p: BPM is running from source with explicit local runtime settings.

postreq.p: Verify health, readiness, the product UI, and first administrative smoke checks.
